feeds.title: Erlang Central Blog
feeds.description: Erlang Central is an informational and community site for programmers, developers, professionals and anyone around the world who's interested in and passionate about the open-source Erlang programming language. Follow us here you will find news, videos, tutorials, jobs, events and other resources related to Erlang programming language.

feeds.title: Erlang Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Though often complex and meticulous, our work enables us to share our passion for Erlang, strengthen global communities and explore the possibilities of technology. We fix issues of scale, reliability & performance. Passionate about Erlang & Elixirlang.

feeds.title: Planet Erlang
feeds.description: Planet Erlang is a metablog that collects posts from the blogs of various Erlang developers and contributors.

feeds.title: Erlang - Ericsson OTP Team Blog
feeds.description: The Erlang/OTP team at Ericsson, the implementors and maintainers of Erlang/OTP. Erlang is a programming language used to build massively scalable soft real-time systems with requirements on high availability.
